book.name: 1 KOLINITA
book.title: Kolinita wali Leta Houwan Pol wana Leleli

content: Bwagana ebo gamagalau analiya tomaha ge tomaha ge aneloseyau analiya na baubaunan, yaa ebo nige no nunuwana i gagan, nau ya ola dulam enonovana ge butuna bwabwatana, o ebo aiyan toto hi tagapopoli butuna.

Bwagana ebo o guyau Yehoba ni pem tage wana baaba na baubaunan, bwagana ebo Yehoba wana nuwatu misusumena na atena o ebo bugul gegewena na atena, bwagana ebo no abulilek ni bwata ge bosowaiu na ba oya abana ni miluwai, yaa ebo nige no nunuwana i gagan, he nau gamagal bwagabwaga hot.
I ola al, bwagana ebo no gogomwau gegewena na guyauan haba togulagula elal, bwagana ebo tuwau na talamwan ni wai, yaa ebo nige no nunuwana i gagan, he nige ana waisi etega na pwapwawa.
Ebo wala nunuwana i gan, ta palahikan ge avalau ta atilomwan-agil. Ebo wala nunuwana i gan, nige avalau ta lalamwa pulowanagil, nige ta babaa heyagila, nige ta hahanaha,
nige ta aawatautau, nige totola wala waisi ta loloyaan, nige etimwawa ta huhuga, avalau wali gegi eliyala nige ta nunuwahikan.
Ebo wala nunuwana i gan, sauga ebo avala etega ni gegi inoke nuwala i nak, yaa pagan sasapona heiya te ta yaliyaya-an.

Ebo wala nunuwana i gan, sauga ebo avala ni ginol panak elala inoke ta nuwayoho ya, sauga gegewena avala ana mel ta teli, sauga gegewena ta atimatuwa te avala wana pagan abwe ni waisi, ge sauga gegewena ta palahikan.

Nunuwana paganina nige ana sauga mowasi ni gagan. Yaa Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana guyau ololana ta palopisai, o ebo anan getoga ona ta baubaunan, o ebo ta baaba alona ge wala aatena, heliya nige nihi mimihot, bwaliga abwe nihi mowasi.
He i ola to, kaiwena sauga ya wala aatena awalehina ya te ta atena, ge ebo ta palopisai, awalehina ya te ta baunan.
Yaa bwaliga abwe Yehoba bugul gegewena ni ginol paolaolaek, inoke sauga o elana hauna toto valila i awalehina abwe ni mowasi.

No sauga wawaya ya papana wawaya ge wawaya nuwatuina ya nuwanuwatu-an. Sauga iyaka ya tau matuwa, inoke wawaya paganina iyaka i mowasi eliyau. Inoke i ola al to, hauna toto sauga ya i awalehina bwaliga abwe ni mowasi.

Sauga ya Yehoba ta kite paganuganu, ana kite i ola ebo kakanunula ta kite gelasi gaganuna elana. Yaa sauga o elana abwe Yehoba ta kite bubun, ana kite ni ola ebo alola ge gamagal etega maninila ta pahanalivaso. Sauga ya no aatena Yehoba kaiwena i awalehina, yaa sauga o elana abwe na atena hoti, ni ola to iya i atenau hoti.
He i ola hiwe. Bugul bwabwatal eton heliya nihi mihot, abulilek, atimatuwa
ge nunuwana, yaa bolo eton o gamwaliyaa, nunuwana heiya te i bwata hot.

footnotes.text: Atimatuwa toto ya, heiya alola wala atimatuwa ta matamatan waisi toto Yehoba abwe ni ginol kaiwela.
